bioghist.head: Biographical/Historical Information
bioghist.p: The Auctioneers Board was established in 1983. A five-member board establishes regulations for obtaining and retaining certification, examines auctioneers for certification, and provides licensure/certification to the approximately 1,500 auctioneers and firms in Virginia. The Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation provides administrative support to the board.

odd.p: These records are part of the Virginia Dept. of Professional and Occupational Regulation record group (RG 17)

Electronic records in this collection are read-only and are only available in the Archives Research Room at the Library of Virginia. A file list is available through the online catalog entry and the link below in the finding aid. Copies are free of charge and may be requested while using the collection in-house. Copies may also be requested by contacting Archives Reference Services. Processing will take from 4-8 weeks.

accessrestrict.p: Attachments must be reviewed for personal information and redacted prior to serving.

scopecontent.p: Minutes and related attachments documenting the meetings, activities, discussions, policy decisions, and recommendations of the Virginia Auctioneers Board. Includes official board minutes, as well as board meeting packets that include agendas, draft minutes from the previous meeting and related attachments such as agreements, correspondence, financial statements, legislation, presentations, public hearing records and comments, regulations and reports. May also include informal fact finding committee minutes.

Electronic records often contain board meeting packets with various attachments and draft minutes, while paper records often include minutes only. There may be some duplication between paper and electronic records.

For transfers prior to 2012, records of individual boards were accessioned separately. After this, transfers of records included all boards, which were accessioned under one accession number. There is a separate finding aid for the later transfers with links provided below.
